name: Perga
line: Perga was a city in Pamphylia where Paul and his companions landed on their first journey, and where they later spoke the word before heading home.

moments.title: John leaves the group
moments.text: Paul and his companions sailed from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. There John left them and returned to Jerusalem.

moments.title: On to Pisidian Antioch
moments.text: From Perga, Paul and his companions traveled inland to Pisidian Antioch.

moments.title: The word spoken in Perga
moments.text: On the way back, they spoke the word in Perga. Then they went down to Attalia.
